home.title: Natural results in expert hands
home.subtitle: Botox, fillers, skin boosters and facial treatments performed by certified specialists. Pick your treatments and book a visit in a minute.

experts.title: Certified specialists
experts.text: Injectable treatments are performed only by qualified, experienced practitioners and preceded by a consultation.

safety.title: Safe, approved products
safety.text: We use only certified preparations and sterile, single-use equipment.

natural.title: Natural look
natural.text: We refresh your features without changing who you are.

home.ctaText: Choose a convenient day and time — it takes less than a minute.

treatments.title: Treatments
treatments.subtitle: Select one or more treatments and continue to booking.
treatments.selectedBar: No treatments selected | 1 treatment selected | {count} treatments selected

botox-1-area.name: Botox – 1 area
botox-1-area.description: Smooths dynamic wrinkles in one area of your choice: forehead, frown lines or crow's feet.

botox-3-areas.name: Botox – 3 areas
botox-3-areas.description: Complete upper-face rejuvenation: forehead, frown lines and crow's feet in a single visit.

botox-bruxism.name: Botox for bruxism
botox-bruxism.description: Relaxes the masseter muscles, relieving teeth grinding and jaw tension while slimming the jawline.

botox-hyperhidrosis.name: Botox for excessive sweating
botox-hyperhidrosis.description: Blocks underarm sweat glands, keeping you dry for up to 6–9 months.

lip-augmentation.name: Lip augmentation
lip-augmentation.description: Hyaluronic acid filler (1 ml) for fuller, well-defined and hydrated lips.

skin-booster.name: Skin booster
skin-booster.description: Intensive hyaluronic acid hydration that improves skin firmness, elasticity and glow.

mesotherapy.name: Needle mesotherapy
mesotherapy.description: A cocktail of vitamins and active ingredients delivered into the skin to revitalise it.

deep-cleansing.name: Deep cleansing facial
deep-cleansing.description: Professional cleansing, exfoliation and hydration for fresh, radiant skin.

chemical-peel.name: Chemical peel
chemical-peel.description: Acid exfoliation that evens skin tone, reduces discolouration and refines pores.

microneedling.name: Microneedling
microneedling.description: Stimulates collagen production to reduce scars, fine lines and enlarged pores.

lash-lift.name: Lash lift & tint
lash-lift.description: Curls and darkens your natural lashes for an open-eyed look lasting up to 6 weeks.

brow-lamination.name: Brow lamination
brow-lamination.description: Styles and sets brow hairs for full, groomed brows — shaping and tint included.
